Construction: N-Tech 2.0 Construction – Nidecker's most advanced manufacturing process combines elements of cap and sandwich construction while shaving weight in the middle of the board. 41. Topsheet: Absorbnid – This innovative top layer has been developed to absorb unwanted vibrations allowing for responsive and dynamic boards that still give you a smooth and comfortable ride. 42. Laminate / fiberglass: Triax Plus – Fiberglass is woven in three directions at 45° for max stiffness. The result of extensive testing, Triax Plus uses different glass densities above and below the core to deliver more consistent torsional flex, better pop, and lightning response. 43. Core material: Mega Core – The most advanced core in Nidecker's line is made from a premium blend of poplar and paulownia. Vertical layers of glass fiber reinforce each stringer to reinforce the flex and add explosive, lifelong snap. 44. Carbon reinforcement: Carbon Cell – A forged carbon section at the heart of the board keeps it ultra stable between your feet and turbocharges response. 45. Base material: N-12000 Graphite Base – Nidecker's fastest ever base is made from race-grade, high density sintered material with added graphite for unmatched glide. 46. Base type: High density sintered with graphite [1] (merchant-verified) 47.
